title: Glowing popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- stick -->
  <rect x="44" y="68" width="12" height="26" rx="3" fill="#d4a373"/>
  <rect x="44" y="68" width="5" height="26" rx="2.5" fill="#e9c46a"/>
  <!-- popsicle body - main part -->
  <rect x="28" y="18" width="44" height="52" rx="14" fill="#ff5d8f"/>
  <!-- popsicle body shading -->
  <rect x="28" y="18" width="18" height="52" rx="14" fill="#ff85a1"/>
  <!-- popsicle top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="30" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#ffb3c6" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- drip lines -->
  <path d="M36 70 q0 8 4 8 q3 0 3-4" fill="#ff5d8f" stroke="none"/>
  <path d="M56 70 q0 10 4 10 q3 0 3-4" fill="#ff5d8f" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="28" ry="36" fill="#ff5d8f" opacity="0.12"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="22" r="2.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="30" r="2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="60" r="2.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="54" r="1.8" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="12" r="2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <!-- sparkle crosses -->
  <path d="M68 16 l2 0 m-1-1 l0 2" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 78 l2 0 m-1-1 l0 2" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
